profile.name: Jun
profile.overview: Jun is a versatile poking, lockdown, and defense-oriented character, excelling at chipping away an opponent's health and frustrating them into pressing into her strong whiff punishment, reversals, and counterhits. She is also known for her extreme safety. She can have a safe df+2 which launches crouchers, and a safe version of the Kazama f+2 launcher, as well as some other safe launching and evasive options. What's the catch? These Kazama Power moves cost health to use, essentially giving the opponent a tiny "punish" without them actually hitting you. This "downside" is further mitigated by her Heat reducing the health-cost of these moves, as well as Jun having a few special moves which recover her health, and her heat smash being designed to heal her. Using the moves which damage and heal you, grants her a unique resource, Kazama Essence, which empowers a number of her key moves when the gauge reaches 100.
profile.playstyle: Poking, lockdown and defence. Chip the opponent down with safe pokes and layered strings, frustrate them with her parry (Inner Peace, f+1+2) and counter-hit tools, and move between Izumo (IZU), Genjitsu (GEN) and Miare (MIA). Some of her Kazama powers cost her own health, which is cheaper in Heat (Wavu). She has no i15 standing launcher.
strengths: Very well-rounded character, with emphasis on poking, defense, and CH tools
Layered string mixups are hard to defend against
Very strong punishment at i10 both crouching and standing
Can launch from crouch at i14
Useful Heat Engagers and and amazing long-range heat smash which recovers a lot of grey health for her
Kazama's Essence improves her already amazing damage by a lot
weaknesses: Can over-spend health trying to poke through the opponent's defenses
Still needs to spend health when trying to mount a comeback at low life
Mediocre frame data on her low pokes, lacks a strong low out of stance

stances.name: Izumo
stances.entry: f+3,2, 1,2,2 and MIA.1+2 transition to it
stances.note: IZU.3 is a Heat Engager; IZU.1,1 tornadoes and is used in her BnB.

stances.name: Genjitsu
stances.note: GEN.4 is a homing high, +4 to +6 on block; GEN.2 ends her tornado combo.

stances.name: Miare
stances.note: Follow-ups after a successful Inner Peace; MIA.1+2 goes into IZU.

heat: Inner Peace (f+1+2) becomes powered up, gaining more parry frames.

keyMoves.summary: Divine Exile - Heaven: i10 high, -14 on block.

keyMoves.purpose: Her i12 punisher (Wavu) and a fast string.

keyMoves.summary: Kazakiri: i17 homing mid, -8 on block.
Getsukankyaku: i19 homing high, +3 to +5 on block.
keyMoves.use: To keep the turn and catch steps.

keyMoves.summary: Mizuho: i16 launcher, launches crouchers. -12 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: Her main launcher (she has no i15 standing launcher).

keyMoves.summary: Katabami: i15 mid, crumples on hit (+48a), -14 on block.
Ichikaku: i11 while-standing kick, -12 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: Fast crouch punisher that gives a juggle (+18a).

keyMoves.summary: Leg Scythe: i18 low, -12 on block.
Inner Peace: i12 parry, +2 on block, powered up in Heat.
keyMoves.purpose: Her parry that leads into Miare.
keyMoves.use: As a read on the opponent's attacks.

keyMoves.summary: Shunkei: i13 mid Heat Engager, -12 on block.
keyMoves.purpose: An i13 punisher that starts Heat.

keyMoves.summary: i12 throw, break with 1 or 2, side switch.
